unit.why: A single anecdote: a Warsaw Jew gives an exceptional etrog to the rebbe of Mogielnica in exchange for a promised son, and a son is born that year.

stories.start_quote: בא ליד איש א׳ מווארשא קודם סכות
stories.summary_en: A childless German-style Jew of Warsaw gives his superb etrog to the rebbe of Mogielnica after R. Yosel promises him a son on the rebbe's behalf; on Sukkot the rebbe hesitates in deep thought, then blesses on it, and a son is born that year, a story later told in wonder by the Gur rebbe.

tags.why: The story is set on Sukkot and turns on the etrog blessing
